description:
The 'Thuko Mat' Campaign was launched in association with the Taxi Union and RTO Mumbai Central, Mumbai, on 6th October. Deputy Commissioner, RTO, Mr. Salunkhe and President Amit Sajjankumar Gupta explained the ill effects of people spitting on roads - it not only makes the city dirty but also taxes resources like water which is required to clean the same.
Taxi drivers appreciated the move and not only promised not to spit but also to ask others not to spit. They willingly put up the stickers and pledged to support the cause.
A huge shout out to Rtn. Munaf Bandukwala for arranging the meeting with the Deputy RTO and Taxi Unions, to Rtn Partner Neha Doshi - the Project Lead, Rtn. PP Rupen Doshi and Rtn. PP Mayuri Bhasin for all the love, support and for attending the same.
Attended by 5 Rotarians
Beneficiaries 2000
Project cost Rs 25,000/-
